newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to review real estate contracts.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to review real estate contracts.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos has ordered a review of all contracts for the Manila Bay real estate development project, the presidential palace said on Monday.
"The President directed that further review of the legal aspects of the contractual arrangements be undertaken and completed not later than December 30, 1996," a Palace statement said.
Executive secretary Ruben Torres said the decision came during a meeting to review the progress of the Boulevard 2000 project.
The project involves the conversion of some 1,500 hectares of reclaimed land into a mixed-use business and cultural centre.
The Public Estates Authority (PEA) has entered into at least seven contracts with different real estate companies to develop the area.
Among them is Amari Coastal Bay Development Corp, a joint venture between Centennial City and Ital-Thai Public Development Public Co Ltd.
A senior senator had questioned the deal, saying that the contract was groslly undervalued. Both the PEA and Amari have denied any wrongdoing.
PEA chairman Arsenio Yulo told reporters that he welcomed the review of the contracts.
"I think the President is very cautious because he wants that all of the legal issues should be resolved. That's a cautious President," Yulo added.
